name: voice-memos
description: Read Apple Voice Memos, maintain their on-demand local transcript cache, and run independent question and health-observation workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Cache and process Voice Memos locally
interface.longDescription: Prompt Voice Memos to synchronize through a hidden background launch, read locally materialized recordings by stable UUID, maintain a private Apple-first and ElevenLabs-backed transcript cache, answer captured questions, and discuss health observations against the health record through independent source-owned workflows.
defaultPrompt: Show my cached Voice Memo transcripts
Answer questions from my new Voice Memos
Discuss health observations from my new Voice Memos
